name: Tytuvėnai Bernardine Monastery House
scope: Standing exterior at Tytuvėnai. The monastery house consists of three two-storey brick wings of unequal mass, a rectangular cloister court and a low glazed link along the church. The brick wings have pitched clay-tile roofs.
era: Standing historic exterior after restoration, with architectural details from original 2008 photographs and written restoration documentation.

review.notes: The exact public-domain photographs in Qualla establish the church, Holy Stairs Chapel and the open courtyard arcade. They do not provide an identifiable exterior of the three monastery house wings. Remaining house photographs carry attribution or share-alike requirements. The model follows the architectural register and OpenStreetMap.
